headline: AI renovation quotes.
Design built in.
input: Notes, photos, plans, rooms and finishes.
review: Check the scope, price and design before anything is sent.
output: Room scope, reviewed price, concepts and finish options.
footer: Your pricing. Your design direction. Human approval.
alt: Illustrative construction workflow: site brief, scope and pricing with interior concepts, estimator and designer approval, then one branded client proposal.

headline: AI client-document checks.
Ready for the next step.
input: Current-period files and approved payroll requirements.
agents: Assign an owner and due date.
review: Confirm missing items and approve the client request.
output: A checked package. A clear next action.
Ready work moves forward; exceptions keep their owner.
footer: Your checklist. Your practice tools. Human approval.
alt: Illustrative accounting workflow: client files and checklist, readiness checks and follow-up draft, coordinator review, then a checked work package with owned exceptions.

headline: AI property-file review.
Evidence beside the issue.
input: Plans, exhibits and the attorney’s jurisdiction rules.
review: The attorney decides significance and any next request.
output: Clear findings and questions for the client conversation.
footer: Source evidence. Legal judgment stays with your attorney.
alt: Illustrative property-law workflow: approved documents and checklist, source comparisons and open questions, attorney review, then a source-linked matter summary.

headline: AI client meeting briefs.
Follow up with context.
input: Authorized CRM records, notes and follow-up dates.
review: The account owner checks context and decides on contact.
output: A prepared call. An owned next step.
Record the actual outcome in your existing CRM.
footer: Relationship context. Partner judgment. Reviewed contact.
alt: Illustrative executive-search business-development workflow: client history and commitments, relationship brief and follow-up draft, partner review, then a prepared call and CRM next action.

headline: AI intake-to-case workflows.
Keep the next step moving.
input: Consultation notes, checked client details and templates.
review: Check case details, recipients and the message before send.
output: An approved request. Tracked case work.
Your team sees what arrived and what is still needed.
footer: Firm templates. Human approval. Attorney-led decisions.
alt: Illustrative immigration-law workflow: approved intake and confirmed case type, document pack and case tasks, authorized review, then a client request and tracked missing items.

headline: AI partner-enquiry follow-up.
Give every lead an owner.
input: Organisation, enquiry type and authorized meeting notes.
review: Check the facts and approve the business message.
output: A clear reply. A dated next action.
Business relationships only; no patient case details.
footer: Website enquiries + optional CRM agent. Human approval.
alt: Illustrative personal-injury care-coordination business workflow: partner enquiry, an optional shared CRM lead and follow-up draft, relationship-owner approval, then a reply and next action. No patient case details.

headline: AI purchase-order intake.
A reviewed route to your ERP.
input: The original PO, customer records and item mappings.
review: Resolve exceptions and approve the consequential update.
output: An ERP order with a visible result.
Keep the source, recorded outcome and failed syncs in view.
footer: Check native ERP features first. Scope the manual gap.
alt: Illustrative distribution workflow: customer PO and approved records, sales-order draft and exception check, order-desk approval, then a recorded ERP order with source and sync status.

headline: AI service renewal drafts.
Keep the next job moving.
input: Customer and site records, terms and pricing rules.
review: Approve scope and price; qualified staff assess findings.
output: An approved proposal. A service handoff.
Track replies and pass accepted work to scheduling.
footer: Check native tools first. Repair-report module is optional.
alt: Illustrative maintenance workflow: due agreements and prior scope, renewal proposals with an optional repair-draft module, service-manager review, then approved proposals and scheduling handoffs.

headline: AI investor meeting context.
Keep your CRM ready.
input: Permitted calendar events, notes and relationship records.
review: Confirm relevance, identity and the permitted change.
output: A reviewed record. A useful next brief.
Record the CRM result; add meeting briefs when scoped.
footer: Check native CRM tools first. Traceable, approved changes.
alt: Illustrative fund investor-relations workflow: approved interactions and CRM history, activity drafts and contact matching, IR review, then recorded CRM updates and an optional meeting brief.
